parameters.name: preferred_language
parameters.description: ISO 639 language; orders returned CGF documents

parameters.name: trust_data
parameters.description: Inline verifiable-trust data for the Corporation DID

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
